subject.title: fix(skills): warn for untrusted local sources

question: Should OpenClaw expose a persistent `skills.load.trustedDirs` warning-suppression setting, or should reviewed-local-source handling use an existing trust or doctor workflow instead?
rationale: The mechanical port is clear, but choosing a permanent user-configurable trust exception changes the security and operator contract beyond a simple stale-path repair.

options.title: Approve narrow trusted roots
options.body: Keep `trustedDirs`, document it as a narrowly scoped reviewed-root exception, and require the implementation to use the active discovery and validated ClawHub paths.

options.title: Avoid a new trust setting
options.body: Retain the local-source warning and redesign suppression through an existing reviewed-install or doctor-owned workflow instead of a persistent config exception.

recommendation.title: Approve narrow trusted roots
recommendation.body: Keep `trustedDirs`, document it as a narrowly scoped reviewed-root exception, and require the implementation to use the active discovery and validated ClawHub paths.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work owns the relevant ClawHub provenance/status-link contract and is the closest evidenced routing candidate.
